TITLE:
Pepper on water —
why does it run away?
NEXT:
Arrow · paper · pepper —
how many did you try?

EN.넓은 접시에\n물을 얕게 부어요:
Pour a little water
into a wide plate
EN.손가락 끝에\n주방 세제를 콕:
Dab a little dish soap
on your fingertip
EN.세제는 눈에 닿지 않게,\n끝나면 손 씻기!:
Keep soap away from your eyes
and wash your hands after!
EN.먼저 맨 손가락으로 콕: First, touch it with a clean finger
EN.이번엔 세제 묻힌 손가락!\n셋 세고 콕:
Now the soapy finger!
Count to three and touch
EN.후추가 가장자리로\n쫙 도망가요!:
The pepper rushes
to the edges!
EN.물 표면의 알갱이는\n서로 꼭 붙잡고 당겨요:
The water at the surface
holds on and pulls together
EN.그래서 표면이 팽팽한 막처럼 돼요\n(표면장력):
So the surface acts like a stretched skin
(surface tension)
EN.세제가 닿은 곳만\n당기는 힘이 약해져요:
Where the soap touches,
the pull gets weaker
EN.둘레의 센 막이 바깥으로 끌어당겨서\n후추도 같이 실려 가요:
The stronger skin around it pulls outward
and carries the pepper along
EN.소금쟁이가 물 위에 서는 것도\n이 팽팽한 막 덕분!:
That stretched skin is also
how water striders stand on water!
EN.세제는 한 방울만, 끝나면 손 씻기!: Just a drop of soap, and wash your hands after!
